p: Jashub: Who also is called Job, Ge 46:13.
whose number was in the days: That is, their number was found to be this big when David counted the people, 2Sa 24:1.
five: Meaning, the four sons and the father.
Jediael: Also called Ashbel, Ge 46:21, Nu 26:38.
three: Who were the chief: or else there were seven in all as it appears in Ge 46:21.
Aher: Meaning that he was not the son of Benjamin, but of Dan Ge 46:23.
the sons of Bilhah: These came from Dan and Naphtali, who were the sons of Bilhah, Ge 46:23,24,25.
his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod: Meaning, the sister of Gilead.
Gath that were born in that: Which was one of the five principal cities of the Philistines and who slew the Ephraimites.
